title: Monster Hunter Wilds Gets 'Ascendance' Expansion in 2027
content:
CAPCOM revealed an expansion for its Monster Hunter Wilds game at the Summer Games Fest event on Friday. The expansion, titled Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance , will launch in 2027.

The Monster Hunter Wilds game debuted globally on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in February 2025. The game sold over 8 million copies worldwide in its first three days. According to the company, this is the fastest that one of its titles has reached this milestone. As of March 2025 the game had sold 10 million copies worldwide.

The first title update for the game launched in April 2025. The second title update launched in June 2025. The third title update featured a collaboration with Final Fantasy XIV Online and launched on October 7.

The game's fourth free title update — which included the Elder Dragon Gogmazios, Arch-Tempered Jin Dahaad, the "Festival of Accord: Lumenhymn" event, armor transcendence, and more — launched on December 16. The update was the "final major content update" for the game that brought the addition of a new monster to the game's roster.
author: ANN

title: Stranger Than Heaven Game's Trailer Reveals Tupac, More Cast, January 15 Release
content:
Sega unveiled during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday a new trailer for Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Stranger Than Heaven game (previously codenamed "Project Century"). The video reveals more cast members, including American rapper Tupac, and the January 15 release for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam . The game will also be available via Game Pass..

The newly announced cast includes:

• Tupac

• Takaya Kuroda (who plays Kazuma Kiryu in Ryu ga Gotoku's related Yakuza/Like a Dragon series)

• Kouhei Tsuji

• Yasukaze Motomiya, who plays Kosei Shishido in the Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name game and Kazuma Kiryu in Nihon Tohitsu's live-action Like a Dragon Powered By Nihon Touitsu series

The game will explore different times and places in Japan's modern history, including Kokura, Fukuoka in 1915; Kure, Hiroshima in 1929; Minami, Osaka in 1943; Atami, Shizuoka in 1951; and the fictional neighborhood of Kamurocho (based on the Kabukicho neighborhood, and a constant setting of RGG Studio's Yakuza/Like a Dragon games) in Shinjuku, Tokyo in 1965.

Sega describes the game's story:

A 50-year saga of those with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. In 1915 San Francisco, a young boy, Makoto Daito, sneaks aboard a suspicious ship in the harbor under the cover of night. Born to an American father and a Japanese mother, Makoto faces harsh persecution due to his Asian heritage. After losing both of his parents, Makoto decides to travel to his mother's homeland, Japan, where a fateful encounter awaits. With nothing but the shirt on his back, Makoto soon learns, however, that his voyage across the Pacific is anything but a "free ride," and that this one choice will forever change the course of his life.

The cast includes:

Sega provided the following comment regarding the character Genzo Iwaki and the model for the character being based on the late actor Bunta Sugawara :

In STRANGER THAN HEAVEN, the late and legendary actor Bunta Sugawara appears. SEGA received formal consent from his family, and, with materials provided by Toei Company Ltd. —which produced many of Mr. Sugawara's films, including the Battles Without Honor and Humanity — RGG Studio crafted his CG character design based on archival footage and photographs from the time.

Snoop Dogg , Satoshi Fujihara , Ado, and Tori Kelly perform the game's theme song "Stranger Than Heaven."

Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties , Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's remake of the Yakuza 3 game along with the new standalone Dark Ties title, launched as a single release for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam worldwide on February 12.

Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii ( Ryū ga Gotoku 8 Gaiden: Pirates in Hawaii ) game launched worldwide for PS4, PS4, Xbox X|S, Xbox One, Windows, and PC via Steam in February 2025.

title: New Virtua Fighter Game Officially Revealed as Virtua Fighter Crossroads in Trailer
content:
Sega and its Ryu ga Gotoku Studio formally revealed the Virtua Fighter Crossroads game for a release in 2027 at the Summer Games Fest event on Friday. The companies originally revealed the latest project Sega 's Virtua Fighter 3D fighting game series in December 2024.

The above trailer describes "A city you've never seen, A story you've never heard, A totally new Virtua Fighter ." The trailer features the new fighter Cielo, and Sega of America stated the game will have an "unconventional new approach to the fighting game genre ... while retaining the series' core legacy of pure, realistic combat with simple controls that made it a pillar of the industry."

The game will have a showcase later today on June 6 at 9:00 a.m. JST (8:00 p.m. EDT).

Sega released the first installment in its long-running Virtua Fighter series in arcades in 1993. The series is notable for its three-button punch/kick/block control system and pioneering use of 3D polygon-based graphics. Sega released five main installments in the series. The developer released the latest main installment, Virtua Fighter 5 , in arcades in 2006. Sega released the latest Virtua Fighter 5 version, Virtua Fighter 5 Final Showdown , in 2010, and on the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2012.

The game franchise received a television anime adaptation in 1995. Tubi TV is streaming the anime in English. Media Blasters released the anime on VHS volumes from 2000 to 2001, and on DVD in 2003.

Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown (also known as Virtua Fighter esports in Japan and arcade releases), a remake of Virtua Fighter 5 in Ryu ga Gotoku's Dragon Engine, launched on PS4 in June 2021.

Ryu ga Gotoku Studio released Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. , a new version of the Virtua Fighter 5 3D fighting game, on PC via Steam in January 2025. The game includes rollback netcode, game balance improvements, and improved graphics and new models.

Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown received a "ver 2.0" update that updated the game to the Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. version.

Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage — an even newer version of the game with a new single player mode, crossplay, and the addition of Dural as a playable character — launched for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam on October 30. The PC via Steam release is a free upgrade for the base Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. game. Those who own the PlayStation 4 version of Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown can purchase Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage at a discount. Any purchased PS4 DLC packs can also be carried over to the PS5 game.

Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage launched for Nintendo Switch 2 on March 26.

title: Platinum Games Announces New Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin Game
content:
Paramount Games announced during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday that Platinum Games is developing a new game in the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise titled Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin .

Paramount Games describes the story, based on a comic book series of the same name: "In a future, battle-ravaged New York City, a lone surviving Turtle embarks on a seemingly hopeless mission seeking justice for the family he lost."

The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin comic book series debuted in October 2020 and ran until April 2022.

Platinum Games previously developed an action game in the franchise titled Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants in Manhattan in 2016 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 3, Xbox One, Xbox 360, and PC.

title: Bandai Namco Announces Gundam: Rogue Orbit Game
content:
Bandai Namco announced during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday a new game in the Gundam franchise titled Gundam Rogue Orbit . The game is scheduled to launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam in 2027.

In the game, players suit up as pilot RE-X and control Gundam Helix, RE-X's high-mobility suit. The game features fast-paced battles, enemy hordes, and bosses. The story is focused on survival against an unknown enemy.

The company will reveal more details in the coming months.

title: Resident Evil: Code Veronica Game Gets Remake
content:
CAPCOM announced during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday Resident Evil Veronica , a remake, or reimagining, of the 2000 Resident Evil: Code Veronica game, for release on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2027. Although the trailer and event's host Geoff Keighley refer to the game as Resident Evil Veronica , the trailer on YouTube titles the game Resident Evil: Code Veronica .

Resident Evil: Code Veronica debuted for Sega Dreamcast in 2000 and received ports for PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, Nintendo GameCube, and Xbox 360.

CAPCOM 's Resident Evil requiem ( Biohazard requiem ) game launched on February 27 for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store. CAPCOM announced on March 16 that the game has crossed 6 million units in cumulative sales worldwide.

Resident Evil 7: biohazard and Resident Evil Village , the seventh and eighth games in the series, respectively, received releases for Switch 2 on February 27. The Resident Evil Generation Pack for Switch 2 includes all three games.

The Resident Evil 4 remake launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC in March 2023, and has sold over 5 million copies worldwide. The game has a "reimagined storyline," and a new graphical art style based on the company's proprietary RE engine.

title: 5 Shonen Anime Heroes Ranked by Their Tragic Stories
content:
Shonen anime protagonists usually follow a familiar mold, one built around heroic energy and the ability to inspire viewers. While this is the standard blueprint for many shonen heroes, there are also plenty who come from very different foundations. Specifically, many shonen protagonists either have tragic backstories or eventually face devastating hardships during their journeys.

This is what makes their inspirational qualities even more profound, as watching them overcome tragedy and adversity can be incredibly motivating. Tragic stories are often a key pillar in shaping a great shonen hero, and there are five in particular whose foundations are defined by tragedy, or whose journeys eventually take a tragic turn. Here, we rank them based on those tragic foundations.

5) Yuji Itadori ( Jujutsu Kaisen )

Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s protagonist, Yuji Itadori, stands out as a unique shonen hero. At first, he does not seem like the perfect fit for the role, but he gradually emerges as one of the genre’s defining modern protagonists. One of the biggest reasons for this is how his journey becomes increasingly tragic as the story progresses, with Yuji repeatedly forced to witness the deaths of those closest to him in some of the most brutal ways imaginable.

Yuji also carries the burden of blaming himself for the massacre caused by Sukuna , openly accepting responsibility and even being willing to face punishment for it. As a result, trauma follows him throughout his journey. What makes his story even more tragic is that Yuji is one of the few shonen protagonists whose dream is never truly realized. His wish was never grand or ambitious; he simply wanted to be surrounded by the people he cared about when he died. Yet, by the end of his journey, even that modest dream is denied to him.

4) Rudo ( Gachiakuta )

The protagonists of Kodansha’s shonen series often have a darker edge, and Rudo from Gachiakuta might be one of the most tragic and unconventional shonen protagonists among them. Rudo’s journey begins with a desire for revenge against the people who wronged him, a narrative foundation that immediately sets him apart from most heroes in the genre.

As a child, Rudo is blamed for the death of his adoptive father, someone who deeply loved him, and is handed the harshest punishment imaginable: being cast into the Pit. The experience leaves him deeply traumatized, to the point that he no longer knows how to smile, while also fostering a darkness within him that constantly drives him to seek justice. Tragically, this mindset has also led him to make questionable decisions, highlighting why Rudo stands out as a compelling modern shonen protagonist

3) Tanjiro Kamado ( Demon Slayer )

Tanjiro Kamado is arguably the kindest shonen anime protagonist on this list, which is surprising considering the tragic circumstances he endured while working tirelessly to provide for his family. On a snowy day, Tanjiro returned home to find his entire family massacred, with his sister transformed into a demon. Such a tragedy would be enough to push many people toward darkness, yet Tanjiro emerged stronger from it.

Tanjiro stood his ground and continued to move forward because he had a new purpose: saving his sister, not avenging his family. While he often appears unfazed by the traumatic event, his emotional maturity consistently reveals how deeply it shaped his character. In many ways, the tragedy became the foundation of the qualities that define Tanjiro as a protagonist.

2) Naruto Uzumaki (Naruto)

Speaking of family loss, Naruto’s tragedy began the moment he was born . His parents sacrificed their lives to protect him, and their final act was sealing the very monster responsible for their deaths inside their son. From childhood, Naruto was feared and ostracized because of the demon he carried within him, despite being completely unaware of the situation himself.

As Naruto grew up, that fear and rejection never disappeared. It pushed him to constantly seek attention from others, actions that were clearly a cry for help and a desire to be loved. Naruto spent his childhood alone and was repeatedly shunned by society, a situation that could have easily turned anyone into a villain. Instead, he chose to become a hero, earning the respect and affection of those around him, making his journey both tragic and inspiring.

1) Denji ( Chainsaw Man )

Chainsaw Man ‘s Denji is arguably the most tragic shonen protagonist of all time, and there is a strong case to be made for it. While most protagonists are focused on protecting their loved ones or becoming better versions of themselves, Denji is simply trying to survive as a human being. Left with the massive debt inherited from his father, Denji was forced into unimaginable circumstances, even selling one of his eyes and a testicle just to stay alive.

Denji has also revealed that, during the most desperate periods of his childhood, he was so hungry that he resorted to eating toilet paper. Because of these experiences, his greatest desires were never grand ambitions but the most basic necessities of life: food, clothes, and a roof over his head. This is perhaps why the final twist of Chainsaw Man is not as bleak as it initially appears, as it ultimately gives Denji a chance at a normal life with those basic necessities. Even then, the events of Parts 1 and 2 only subjected him to further tragedy. As a result, Denji’s foundation alone makes him one of the most tragic shonen anime heroes ever, with few characters coming close to the hardships he has endured

Even then, the events of Parts 1 and 2 only subjected him to further tragedy. As a result, Denji’s foundation alone makes him one of the most tragic shonen anime heroes ever, with few characters coming close to the hardships he has endured

title: Manga Creator Ritsuhiro Mikami Dies
content:
The official X/Twitter account for Kadokawa 's Flos Comic website revealed on Friday that manga creator Ritsuhiro Mikami died on April 17 due to illness.

Mikami drew the Akuyaku Reijо̄ ni Tensei Shippai-shite Kachi Heroine ni Natteshimatta: Akuyaku Reijо̄ no Ani to no Kazoku End wo Akiramete Koibito End wo Mezashimasu manga, and had just almost completed the second part of a one-shot story to commemorate the first anniversary since the series' completion. Flos Comic will announce the release for the second part at a later date.

Mikami drew a special one-shot spinoff for Kazuya Minekura 's Saiyuki manga in February 2021. Mikami's other manga also included Momotarо̄-kun wa Iu Koto wo Kikanai , Worldend:Debugger , and Bakuro Roku .

title: Crunchyroll Hidden Gem Fantasy Confirms Sequel After 2 Years With First Teaser
content:
Crunchyroll is planning to have a big summer, with next month’s Anime Expo slated to see the streaming service make a serious splash. The platform is planning to focus on series such as Gachiakuta, Demon Slayer, Daemons of the Shadow Realm, The Apothecary Diaries, Witch Hat Atelier , and many more. While the streaming service has its fair share of plans for next month, it is also planning to bring back another big series that many thought might never return. Once again exploring the world of fantasy, Crunchyroll has a look at a second season that fans have been waiting years to see.

For those who might not know, Sasaki and Peeps is a story that might seem familiar to many fantasy fans, aka seeing a man dragged into a fantasy landscape that is far beyond their imagination, but its premise is much different. Deciding to adopt a pet bird, Sasaki realizes that said bird is the reincarnation of a powerful wizard, throwing a major magical monkey wrench into his life. Set to release later this year, Studio Silver Link is planning to release season two later this year, though a specific release date remains a mystery. You can check out the latest trailer for the dynamic duo’s return below.

Peeps & Sasaki: A Match Made in Heaven

If you haven’t had the opportunity to check out Sasaki and Peeps, here’s how Crunchyroll describes the series that arrived in the anime world in 2024, “Sasaki is a middle-aged office worker living in Japan. Feeling drained by the vapid corporate world, he heads to the pet shop in search of a new companion. There he finds an adorable bird named Peeps and takes him home. But Sasaki quickly learns that Peeps isn’t your average bird…he’s a powerful mage from another world! Together, they embark on a magical adventure filled with swords and sorcery.”

Sasaki and Peeps first debuted as a novel series in 2018, quickly receiving light novels, manga, and the eventual anime adaptation. Considering that the story is still continuing to this day, it is entirely possible that the anime would have enough material to create a season three and beyond. Considering how big the isekai genre has become in recent years, now might be the perfect time for the series to return to capitalize on the genre. Luckily, the original cast of the anime’s first season will return , which includes Tomokazu Sugita as Sasaki, Aoi Yuki as Pii-chan, Rie Takahashi as Hoshizaki, Akari Kito as Otonori-san, and Miyu Tomita as Elsa.

The studio responsible for this wild adventure, Silver Link, has been a heavy hitter in the anime industry in recent years. To date, the production house has been responsible for animating the likes of Mission: Yozakura Family, Ragna Crimson, The Misfit of Demon King Academy , and far more.

What do you think of the anime bird and his mundane partner returning to the screen later this year? Leave a comment below and join the conversation now in the ComicBook Forum !
